# Security policy

Security fixes target the current `main` branch. These services are experimental;
include the affected commit when reporting a problem.

Report vulnerabilities privately using [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/princebyyourlogic/cod2-bro-stun-server-replacement/security/advisories/new).
Include the affected component, steps to reproduce, and expected impact.

Keep credentials, private deployment details, player addresses, and raw captures
out of public issues and pull requests. Ordinary bugs can use public issues with
sensitive details removed.
